title: BankFinding

rule.description: A bank validator rule's id; data/bank-validator-rules.json says what each refuses or warns of.

severity.description: refusal: the bank or the write is refused; warning: reported, nothing refused.

path.description: The file or folder it is about, relative to the bank's root: BANK.md, projects/acme/web/, or a memory's file.

field.description: The field of the file it is about, where it is one: purpose, orientation, topics, description, body.

secret.description: secret_shaped only: the shape rule that found it, or registered-value; never the value.

message.description: What is wrong and what to do, for the bank's author; never a secret's value.

description: One finding of the bank validator: the rule's id, refusal or warning, the path and field it is about, and an actionable message.
